hooks.name: Ukrainian Translation Review
hooks.description: Reminds whoever edited po/uk.po to check the new msgstr entries against the Ukrainian Style Guide. The prompt states the criteria directly instead of ordering the agent to invoke the uk-translation-reviewer sub-agent: when the reviewer itself saves po/uk.po the hook fires inside it, and it has no tool to invoke itself — it reported exactly that. Stating the criteria makes the instruction actionable by whichever agent is running.

action.prompt:
po/uk.po was saved. Review only the msgstr entries you just added or changed — do not re-audit the whole catalogue.

If you have the `uk-translation-reviewer` sub-agent available, delegate to it. If you ARE that reviewer, or the sub-agent is not in your tool set, do the review yourself against the Ukrainian Style Guide:

1. Terminology follows the project's DSTU vocabulary. In particular `з'єднання` is banned — the established forms are `з'єднок` / `з'єднанка` / `з'єднки`. Check the surrounding entries for the term already in use rather than inventing one.
2. Kharkiv orthography, including в/у euphony (`утрачено` after a consonant, `втрачено` after a vowel).
3. Imperative mood for UI actions; a verbal noun for a status message reporting an action in progress (`перевіряння`, not `перевірка`, when something is happening now).
4. Straight ASCII apostrophe, matching the rest of the file.
5. Every `{}` placeholder from the msgid is preserved, and no msgid is modified.
6. Do not add or remove trailing ellipses that the msgid does not have.

Then verify with `./scripts/check-po-complete.sh uk` — it must report the catalogue complete. Report what you changed and why, briefly. If nothing needed changing, say so in one line.
